_comment: Divergences check_conservation.py has found and that are tracked as open
issues. An entry is a licence to keep failing, not a rule saying the
divergence is legitimate — legitimate ones are named rules in the tool.
`lines` is exact: fixing half of a defect fails the check until the entry
is updated or removed, so the baseline cannot quietly absorb a partial fix.
No book text here, deliberately. `id` is the first 10 hex of the sha256 of
the whitespace-normalised line, which is what the tool reports; the issue
each entry names carries the readable version. Run the tool with
--show-text locally to see what an id refers to.
